questions.prompt: The model calls count_lines with {"path": 42}. What happens?
options: The body runs and fails when readFile gets a number
The argument check fails, the body never runs, and the model gets an error result naming /path
The harness converts 42 to the string "42" and runs the body
The harness drops the call and sends nothing back
questions.explanation: defineTool checks the arguments against the compiled schema before the body. A mismatch throws, so the loop returns a tool error result that names the wrong field.

questions.prompt: Why does the body of count_lines return the number 42 instead of the text "42 lines"?
options: Because the model cannot read text in a tool result
Because numbers use fewer tokens than text
So other code can use the value directly, and text is made from it in one place by render
Because JSON Schema does not allow strings as output
questions.explanation: The value is data of a declared shape. The render function turns it into text for the model, so no caller ever has to parse a sentence to get the number back.

questions.prompt: Where does the "required" list in the schema the model sees come from?
options: From each parameter marked required: true in the one definition
From a second schema written by hand
questions.explanation: toJsonSchema collects every parameter with required: true into the required list, so the schema and the check come from the same description.
